title: clinthresh: Clinical Thresholds, Equivalence Tests and Replicability Tools for Sports Medicine Research
description: R package and web app to read and design sports medicine and rehabilitation studies against thresholds of clinical importance: the range of thresholds for which a published result's conclusions hold, equivalence, minimum-effect and non-inferiority tests, interval classification, SWC, SEM, MDC, small-telescopes bounds, equivalence and non-inferiority sample sizes, and a sourced reference table of minimal important differences labeled within-patient, between-group or either. Companion software for the review "Statistically Significant, Clinically Meaningful, or Neither? Clinical Thresholds and Equivalence Testing in Sports Medicine Rehabilitation" (Current Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation Reports).
